title: Mhirizhonga paSuo Rinopfuta
intro: Boka revanhu vakanyarara, vanotyisa vanomira vachitarisa pachikumbaridzo chinotyisa, vasingamboravi chikafu, chinwiwa, kana kuzorora. Vakagadzirwa nechinhu chisina kufanana nevhu revanhu, vanomirira chinangwa chimwe chete chinotyisa—uye havana kumboteerera kana murairo mumwe chete wakabva kuna Ishe wavo.
clues: Isu tiri zvisikwa zvakasiyana nevanhu, takasikwa kubva muchinhu chisingadyi, chisinganwi, kana kuneta.
Nhamba yedu chaiyo inozivikanwa uye inoziviswa mubhuku—hatisi vazhinji kana kuti vazhinji.
Hatina kumbobvira tateerera Musiki wedu, uye hatimbotauri tisati tarayirwa.
Kana Zuva rasvika, vasingatendi vachaendeswa kwatiri vari mumapoka, uye tichavavhurira masuo.
Tichavabvunza kuti: 'Havana kuuya kwamuri here nhume kubva kurudzi rwenyu, vachikuyambirai nezvezuva rino?'
Tinochengetedza nzvimbo isina mweya unobuda mairi—nzvimbo inopisa yekurangwa kusingaperi.
